messages.subject: For Christel Bories | Critical minerals, government relations and responsible growth
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Amrani,

Please place this executive introduction before Ms. Christel Bories, Chair and Chief Executive Officer.

Eramet's international critical-minerals portfolio places host-country relationships, community confidence, responsible mining and strategic partnerships close to growth execution. Those priorities align strongly with the work I lead today at the intersection of government, communities, ESG and mining operations.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead institutional engagement, coordinate multi-agency and community matters, and translate external obligations into internal owners, evidence, timelines and escalation across operating and corporate functions. I also support external governance around a major solar and battery-storage platform and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using physical operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of responsible-mining, government-relations and country execution might support Eramet's international growth. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Eramet.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
